description: For deficiency notice, this log form records nonconforming condition, required correction, protection measures, response deadline, and potential consequences. Its supporting evidence includes photos, test failures, inspection record, correspondence, specification excerpt, and prior notice history.

blocks.guidance: Link this deficiency notice record to its evidence.
blocks.label: Deficiency Notice Record and Routing

blocks.guidance: Capture contract requirement, affected work, location, responsible party, discovery date, and related inspection for this deficiency notice.
blocks.label: Deficiency Notice Core Identifiers

sections.guidance: Identify contract requirement, affected work, location, responsible party, discovery date, and related inspection for this deficiency notice record.
sections.title: Log Reference and Review Owner

blocks.guidance: For deficiency notice, record photos, test failures, inspection record, correspondence, specification excerpt, and prior notice history.
blocks.label: Deficiency Notice Findings, Measurements, and Evidence

blocks.guidance: Cite every deficiency notice evidence source.
blocks.label: Deficiency Notice Evidence Sources

blocks.guidance: Keep deficiency notice items open through verification.
blocks.label: Deficiency Notice Open Items and Next Actions

blocks.guidance: Transfer unresolved deficiency notice entries by reference.
blocks.label: Deficiency Notice Period Reconciliation

blocks.guidance: For deficiency notice, explain cure proposal, verified correction, cost or schedule reservation, acceptance, and notice closure; transfer each deficiency notice open entry to the deficiency notice successor record and named owner.
blocks.label: Deficiency Notice Period Transfer Notes

blocks.guidance: Stop or protect affected work when continued activity could conceal, compound, or create unsafe deficiency. Route unresolved deficiency notice work for review.
blocks.label: Deficiency Notice Applicable Review Boundary

sections.guidance: Support deficiency notice findings with photos, test failures, inspection record, correspondence, specification excerpt, and prior notice history.
sections.title: Recorded Findings and Actions

subtitle: Deficiency Notice Log Form: formal construction deficiency notice and cure tracking using contract requirement, nonconforming condition, and photos.
title: Deficiency Notice Log Form
use_case: Use the log form during formal construction deficiency notice and cure tracking when the deficiency notice record must identify contract requirement, affected work, location, responsible party, discovery date, and related inspection. Complete the applicable handoff for cure proposal, verified correction, cost or schedule reservation, acceptance, and notice closure.
